# Data Preparation

## Load and merge Gender Data

```{r Load and merge gender data}
# load Coping 
dat_gender_coping_nbr <- read_rds(
  file = paste0(filepath_cleaned_data_coping_nbr,"dat_after_exclusion_gender_coping_nbr", date, ".rds")
)

# load Glad 
dat_gender_glad <- read_rds(
  file = paste0(filepath_cleaned_data,"dat_after_exclusion_gender", date, ".rds")
)

# combine
dat_gender <- bind_rows(
  dat_gender_coping_nbr %>% select(ID, gender),
  dat_gender_glad %>% select(ID, gender)
)
```

## Load and merge PRS Data

```{r Load data PRS}

load_and_combine_prs <- function(path_glad, path_coping) {
  #  (Coping)
  dat_coping <- read.table(path_coping, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  dat_coping$study_status <- "COPING"
  
  #  (Glad)
  dat_glad <- read.table(path_glad, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  dat_glad$study_status <- "GLAD"
  
  # combine
  return(bind_rows(dat_glad, dat_coping))
}

# PRS data load
dat_prs_dep_comb     <- load_and_combine_prs(filepath_prs_depression, filepath_prs_depression_no_mhd)
dat_prs_anxiety_comb <- load_and_combine_prs(filepath_prs_anxiety, filepath_prs_anxiety_no_mhd)
dat_prs_an_comb      <- load_and_combine_prs(filepath_prs_an, filepath_prs_an_no_mhd)
dat_prs_bipolar_comb <- load_and_combine_prs(filepath_prs_bipolar, filepath_prs_bipolar_no_mhd)
dat_prs_ptsd_comb    <- load_and_combine_prs(filepath_prs_ptsd, filepath_prs_ptsd_no_mhd)
dat_prs_scz_comb     <- load_and_combine_prs(filepath_PRSCS_scz, filepath_prs_scz_no_mhd)
```

## Load Principal Components

```{r data principal componance}
dat_prs_pc <- read.table(filepath_prs_pc, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_pc_subset <- dat_prs_pc[, c("FID", "batch", "pc1", "pc2", "pc3", "pc4", "pc5", "pc6")]
```

## Merge All Data (PRS + Gender + PCs)

```{r merge gender}
merge_all_data <- function(prs_data, gender_data, pc_data) {
  merged_step1 <- merge(prs_data, gender_data, by.x = "FID", by.y = "ID")
  merged_step2 <- merge(merged_step1, pc_data, by = "FID")
  return(merged_step2)
}

merged_dep_g     <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_dep_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_anxiety_g <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_anxiety_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_an_g      <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_an_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_bipolar_g <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_bipolar_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_ptsd_g    <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_ptsd_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_scz_g     <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_scz_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)

table(merged_dep_g$gender, merged_dep_g$study_status)
```

```{r regression}
model_dep_g     <- lm(SCORE ~ gender + study_status + pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 + batch, data=merged_dep_g)
model_anxiety_g <- lm(SCORE ~ gender + study_status + pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 + batch, data=merged_anxiety_g)
model_an_g      <- lm(SCORE ~ gender + study_status + pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 + batch, data=merged_an_g)

summary(model_dep_g)
```

# multinomial regression

```{r multinomial sensitivity function}
# Referenzgruppe auf Cis-Frauen setzen
merged_dep_g$gender <- relevel(as.factor(merged_dep_g$gender), ref = "Cis woman")

# irgendwas geändert
multinom.estimates <- function(
  outcome, explanatory_variables, adjustment = c(), data_set, 
  population = "Full sample", name = "Model1", regression = "Multinomial", 
  time_point = "t1", duration = "cross-sectional"
) {
  
  dependent.variable <- outcome
  explanatory.variable <- explanatory_variables
  covariates <- adjustment
  independent.variables <- c(explanatory.variable, covariates)
  
  multinom.formula <- as.formula(paste(dependent.variable, paste(independent.variables, collapse=" + "), sep=" ~ "))
  
  
  temp_df_for_multinom <<- get(data_set)
  
  assign(paste0(outcome, ".", name),
         multinom(formula = multinom.formula, data = temp_df_for_multinom)
  )
  
  assign(paste0(outcome, name, "_estimates"),
         tidy(
           get(paste0(outcome, ".", name)),
           conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE
         ) %>%
           add_column("Model" = name, .before = "term") %>%
           add_column("Regression" = regression, .before = "Model") %>%
           add_column("Sample" = population, .before = "Model") %>%
           add_column("Time point" = time_point, .before = "Model") %>%
           add_column("Duration" = duration, .before = "Model") %>%
           mutate(
             "Dependent variable" = dependent.variable,
             "Level" = y.level,
             "Independent variable" = recode_factor(term, "(Intercept)" = "Intercept"),
             "Estimate" = as.numeric(format(round(estimate, digits = 2), nsmall = 2)),
             "95% CI low" = as.numeric(format(round(conf.low, digits = 2), nsmall = 2)),
             "95% CI up" = as.numeric(format(round(conf.high, digits = 2), nsmall = 2)),
             "SE" = as.numeric(format(round(std.error, digits = 2), nsmall = 2)),
             "z score" = as.numeric(format(round(statistic, digits = 2), nsmall = 2)),
             "p value" = case_when(
               p.value < 0.001 ~ formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),
               p.value >= 0.001 & p.value < 0.01 ~ formatC(p.value, format = "f", digits = 3),
               p.value >= 0.01 ~ formatC(p.value, format = "f", digits = 2)
             )
           ) %>%
           select(
             "Sample", "Time point", "Duration", "Model", "Regression",
             "Dependent variable", "Level", "Independent variable",
             "Estimate", "95% CI low", "95% CI up", "SE", "z score", "p value"
           )
  )
  return(get(paste0(outcome, name, "_estimates")))
}
```

```{r run multinomial depression}
ergebnisse_multinomial_dep <- multinom.estimates(
  outcome = "gender",
  explanatory_variables = "SCORE",
  adjustment = c("study_status", "pc1", "pc2", "pc3", "pc4", "pc5", "pc6", "batch"),
  data_set = "merged_dep_g", 
  name = "Multinom_Depression"
)

print(ergebnisse_multinomial_dep)


ergebnisse_multinomial_dep_ohne_study_status <- multinom.estimates(

)

print(ergebnisse_multinomial_dep_ohne_study_status)

beide_varianten <- bind_rows(

View(beide_varianten)

write.csv(beide_varianten, 
          file = paste0(LGBTQ_folder, "tables/", date, "/multinominale_regression_both_variants", date, ".csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Vergleichstabellen mit und ohne kontrolle}
phenotypes <- c("dep", "anxiety", "an", "bipolar", "ptsd", "scz")
comparison_folder <- paste0(LGBTQ_folder, "tables/", date, "/study_status_comparison/")

if (!dir.exists(comparison_folder)) {
  dir.create(comparison_folder, recursive = TRUE)
}

#Loop über alle Datensätze
for (ph in phenotypes) {
  
  dataset_name <- paste0("merged_", ph, "_g")
  
  if (exists(dataset_name)) {
    message("--- Starte Analyse für: ", dataset_name, " ---")
    
    # A) Modell MIT study_status
    res_with <- multinom.estimates(
      outcome = "gender",
      explanatory_variables = "SCORE",
      adjustment = c("study_status", "pc1", "pc2", "pc3", "pc4", "pc5", "pc6", "batch"),
      data_set = dataset_name, 
      name = paste0("Multinom_", ph, "_With_Control")
    )
    res_with$Model_Variant <- "With Study Status"
    
    # B) Modell OHNE study_status
    res_without <- multinom.estimates(
      outcome = "gender",
      explanatory_variables = "SCORE",
      adjustment = c("pc1", "pc2", "pc3", "pc4", "pc5", "pc6", "batch"),
      data_set = dataset_name, 
      name = paste0("Multinom_", ph, "_No_Control")
    )
    res_without$Model_Variant <- "Without Study Status"
    
    comparison_table <- rbind(res_with, res_without)
    
    output_file <- paste0(comparison_folder, "comparison_", ph, "_", date, ".csv")
    write.csv2(comparison_table, file = output_file, row.names = FALSE)
    
  } else {
    message("Warnung: Datensatz ", dataset_name, " wurde nicht gefunden.")
  }
}

```

```{r Tabelle  effektgrößen und regressionsstatistiken}
dateien <- list.files(path = comparison_folder, pattern = "comparison_.*\\.csv", full.names = TRUE)

alle_daten <- dateien %>%
  lapply(function(x) read.csv2(x, check.names = FALSE)) %>%
  bind_rows()

# sort table
tabelle_sortiert <- alle_daten %>%
  # just Haupteffekte
  filter(`Independent variable` == "SCORE") %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = gsub("Multinom_", "", Model)) %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = gsub("_With_Control|_No_Control", "", Phenotype)) %>%
  arrange(Phenotype, Level, desc(Model_Variant)) %>%
  select(Phenotype, Level, Model_Variant, Estimate, SE, `z score`, `p value`)

write.csv2(tabelle_sortiert, 
           file = paste0(comparison_folder, "Tabelle_1_Effektgroessen_SORTIERT_", date, ".csv"), 
           row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Tabelle 2}
stats_liste <- list()

for (ph in phenotypes) {
  dataset_name <- paste0("merged_", ph, "_g")
  
  if (exists(dataset_name)) {
    dat <- get(dataset_name)
    
    # 1. Model with control (Full Model)
    m_with <- multinom(gender ~ SCORE + study_status + pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 + batch, 
                       data = dat, trace = FALSE)
    
    # 2. Model without controll (Reduced Model)
    m_without <- multinom(gender ~ SCORE + pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 + batch, 
                          data = dat, trace = FALSE)

    stats_liste[[ph]] <- data.frame(
      Phenotype = ph,
      Model_Variant = c("With Study Status", "Without Study Status"),
      AIC = c(AIC(m_with), AIC(m_without)),
      LogLikelihood = c(as.numeric(logLik(m_with)), as.numeric(logLik(m_without))),
      Residual_Deviance = c(deviance(m_with), deviance(m_without)),
      N_Observations = c(nrow(m_with$residuals), nrow(m_without$residuals))
    )
  }
}

tabelle_2_stats <- bind_rows(stats_liste)

write.csv2(tabelle_2_stats, 
           file = paste0(comparison_folder, "Tabelle_2_Regressionsstatistiken_", date, ".csv"), 
           row.names = FALSE)

View(tabelle_2_stats)
```

```{r table small}
supp_table_data <- master_tabelle_sensitivitaet %>%
  filter(`Independent variable` == "SCORE") %>%
  mutate(
    Model = case_when(
      Model == "multinomial_Multinom_Depression" ~ "Depression",
      Model == "multinomial_Anxiety" ~ "Anxiety",
      Model == "multinomial_an" ~ "Anorexia Nervosa",
      Model == "multinomial_Bipolar" ~ "Bipolar Disorder",
      Model == "multinomial_PTSD" ~ "PTSD",
      Model == "multinomial_SCZ" ~ "Schizophrenia",
      TRUE ~ Model
    ),
    `OR [95% CI]` = paste0(
      format(round(as.numeric(Estimate), 2), nsmall = 2), " [", 
      format(round(as.numeric(`95% CI low`), 2), nsmall = 2), " - ", 
      format(round(as.numeric(`95% CI up`), 2), nsmall = 2), "]"
    ),
    p_num = as.numeric(`p value`),
    `p-value` = ifelse(p_num < 0.001, "<.001", format(round(p_num, 3), nsmall = 3))
  ) %>%

  select(
    `Psychiatric Disorder` = Model,
    `Gender Identity` = Level,
    `OR [95% CI]`,
    `p-value`
  )
```
